methods.name: h
methods.description: Resets the color selection UI, clearing styles and values.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Handles color cell click events, updating selected color.

methods.name: m
methods.description: Handles mouseover/mouseout events on color cells.

methods.description: Resets border styles on color cells.

methods.name: o
